findings.finding: Observation of a model prior to physical practice facilitates the acquisition of motor skills.
findings.quote: Observation of a model prior to physical practice often facilitates the acquisition of motor skills.

findings.finding: Visual guidance directing gaze to relevant regions during observation improves motor skill execution and retention.
findings.quote: our results suggest that visual guidance to cued areas during observational learning of complex motor skills may accelerate acquisition of the skill.

principle: Watching a model perform helps learners acquire motor skills, and guiding their visual attention to key features further accelerates this learning.
for_the_teacher: Show the movement demonstration clearly before letting learners practice physically.
Highlight key parts of the body or setup on screen to guide the learner's gaze during demonstrations.
